name: What to Do Immediately for a Plumbing Emergency in Paradise

step.name: Step 1: Shut off the water supply – Locate your main water shut-off valve, usually near your water meter or where the main line enters your home. Turn it clockwise to cut off the water flow, which is the single most important action you can take to stop water damage from escalating. If you can't find the main shutoff, try turning off the valve at the specific fixture if one is present.
step.text: Step 1: Shut off the water supply – Locate your main water shut-off valve, usually near your water meter or where the main line enters your home. Turn it clockwise to cut off the water flow, which is the single most important action you can take to stop water damage from escalating. If you can't find the main shutoff, try turning off the valve at the specific fixture if one is present.

step.name: Step 2: Open a low-level faucet – After shutting off the main water, open the lowest faucet in your home to drain any remaining water from the pipes. This helps relieve pressure in the system and further reduces potential leakage from the affected area. It's a simple step that can prevent more water from escaping.

step.name: Step 3: Keep water away from electrical equipment – If water is near electrical outlets, appliances, or wiring, immediately turn off the power to that area at your electrical panel. Water and electricity are a dangerous combination, and ensuring your safety is paramount. Do not touch wet electrical devices or standing water near power sources.

step.name: Step 4: Document the damage – Use your phone to take photos or videos of the leak, water damage, and any affected areas. This documentation can be extremely helpful for insurance claims later on. It also provides valuable information for your plumber to understand the scope of the issue before they even arrive.

step.name: Step 5: Call a professional emergency plumber – Once the immediate crisis is contained and documented, call CG Plumbing Solutions at (702) 843-0899. Describe the situation clearly: where the leak is, if you've shut off the water, if sewage is involved, and if there's any electrical hazard. Our team can provide prompt, code-compliant service for urgent leaks, sewer backups, and other time-sensitive plumbing failures.
step.text: What to Do Next If you're in the middle of a plumbing emergency in Paradise, follow these steps and then call CG Plumbing Solutions for immediate, expert assistance.
